concepts.quote: a = b moves the value out of b's box into a's, so b is empty
concepts.why: Assignment copies the right-hand value and leaves b unchanged; claiming b becomes empty contradicts Java.

concepts.quote: Variables are boxes ... so b is empty
concepts.why: Treats a variable as a physical box that can be emptied; a Java variable always holds exactly one value, and reading it does not remove it.

concepts.quote: That is why we need t
concepts.why: The temporary is justified by a wrong 'moving' model (b emptied) rather than by a = b overwriting a's old value, so the explanation of the swap rests on a rule that contradicts Java.
